Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS: 2843 -1964 

Indian Standard 

RECOMMENDATION ON NOMINAL 

CAPACITIES FOR PROCESS EQUIPMENT 

0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution 
on 18 August 1964, after the draft finalized by the Chemical Engineering 
Sectional Committee had been approved by the Mechanical Engineering 
Division Council. 

0.2 Chemical equipment come in various capacities and are designed to 
various temperature and pressure conditions. To help the fabricator to 
offer standard equipment and for the user to order equipment on such 
basis, it is very necessary to lay down a rationalized series of preferred 
capacities, diameters, temperatures and pressures. 

0.3 The capacities recommended in this standard are based on series of 
preferred numbers {see IS : 1076-1957* ), R5 series being used up to 
1 000 litre capacities and R 10 series after that. 

0,4 In preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been taken 
from DIN 28100-1952 Nominal capacities of chemical equipment, issued 
by the Deutscher Normenausschuss, 

0.5 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this 
standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, express- 
ing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2-19601. 
The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should 
be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. 



1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard deals with the nominal capacities of containers and 
process vessels used in chemical industry. 

2. TERMINOLOGY 

2.0 For the purpose of this standard, the following definition shall apply, 

•Preferred nurribers. ( Since revised ). 

f Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised ) . 



IS: 2843 -1964 

2.1 Nominal Capacity — The capacity used in designating the process 
vessel. It is a rounded off ( lower ) value of the calculated capacity of the 
container which includes the volume of the lids and dished ends, but does 
not include the volume o£ nozzles and corrections due to internals, 

3. NOMINAL CAPACITY 

3.1 The recommended nominal capacities shall be as given in Table 1. 

TABLE 1 RECOMMENDED NOMINAL CAPACITIES 

{Capacities in litres ) 

10 100 1000 10 000 100 000 

16 160 

25 250 

40 400 

63 630
